replacement.name: Acron Waterfront Resort Alibaug
replacement.tagline: Goa-based Acron Group's Alibaug resort with infinity pool overlooking the Arabian Sea — 60 rooms, the boutique mid-range pick between the Radisson 5-star and value beach homestays.

replacement.name: Fariyas Resort Alibaug
replacement.tagline: Direct Varsoli-beach walkout — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, the closest 4-star to Alibaug fort. Pre-dates the chain 5-stars and still holds the strongest beach access.

existing.name: Varsoli Riverside Farmstay
existing.issue: template-sounding — Varsoli is a beach not a river; 'Riverside Farmstay' likely a hallucinated listicle pick. The genuine xfactor in Alibaug is private SaffronStays/StayVista villas but these rotate too fast for a fixed pick
